title: Dialysis Patient Transfer — Neighboring Hospital Availability

transcript.speaker: Neighbor Transfer Center
transcript.text: This is the transfer center at a neighboring hospital, outside the advisory area. We can take six of your outpatients on our dialysis unit and four inpatients tomorrow. For the inpatients we need physician-to-physician handoff, the last 48 hours of labs, and the code status. What is your timeline?

transcript.speaker: Dr. Anita Shah
transcript.text: Understood. We have two inpatients with potassium above 6.0 who cannot wait. I will send the handoff notes and lab copies via secure messaging to your unit contact, Dr. Shah. Code status is full code for both. We need to move them today. I will confirm with the CMO.

transcript.speaker: Neighbor Transfer Center
transcript.text: Confirmed. We will hold six beds for outpatients and four inpatient spots. We expect the handoff notes and labs by 09:30 today. Please send a secure message to Dr. Shah at rivas@maplewoodregional.example with the full set.

instructorNote: This inject confirms the transfer plan and triggers the CMO to approve urgent transfers. Watch for the CMO to be prompted to approve the inpatient moves and for the Liaison Officer to update the Patient Movement Log.
